correctness.rationale: Six microstates and all energy changes are exhaustively determined from the four-spin Hamiltonian. The three reversal-pair stationary weights solve all six microscopic balance equations. Algebraic substitution proves both local correlation formulas and the exact hot heat flux; reservoir balance gives entropy production. Positive denominator, sign inequalities and strict derivative establish the threshold; a monotonicity argument proves the unique infinite-hot dissipation maximum and its alignment-region location. Standalone SymPy checks reconstruct the generator independently and pass six symbolic master equations, eighteen exact rational solves and eighteen entropy-production computations. Claims exclude zero cold temperature and thermodynamic limits.

Full relevant same mathematical model material was inspected; no coverage of this exact four-site one-hot-edge two-temperature correlation sign boundary and entropy optimum was found. Related exact correlations use spin-flip dynamics, and a Kawasaki comparison is two-dimensional. The inspected literature did not show implication or duplication; this remains a best-knowledge originality determination rather than uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: The four-site zero-magnetization ring is provably the smallest periodic conserved Ising model with temperature-sensitive energy-changing exchange. Its complete exact stationary solution identifies a sharp boundary between dissipative nonequilibrium steady state (every unequal bath pair) and positive local alignment (a stronger hot-bath threshold), and locates the unique hot-infinite-temperature entropy-production optimum relative to that boundary. This interpretable minimal benchmark resolves a natural local ordering question rather than an arbitrary fixed table entry. No thermodynamic transition is claimed.
